entries.proposition: Thymidine supplementation (10 uM for 40 days) suppressed double-strand-break formation in Fhit knockout mouse kidney cells only, to a tail moment like wild type; this is a nucleotide-supply rescue of a Fhit-TK1 lesion, with no thymidine experiment in Wwox-deficient cells.
entries.snippet: Low level concentration (10 μM) thymidine supplementation for 40 days suppressed DSB formation in −/− cells only (Fig. 1F)

experimental_context.system: mouse kidney cell lines (Fhit +/+ and -/-), five human breast cancer lines, mouse embryonic fibroblasts (Wwox ko), Kaplan-Meier Plotter ovarian cohort, TCGA squamous lung expression
experimental_context.genotype: Fhit loss (thymidine axis); Wwox deficiency by endogenous expression or knockout MEFs

entries.proposition: The Wwox survival claim rests on five breast cancer lines classified as expressing (two) or deficient (three) by endogenous expression: the two expressors show about 10-fold lower survival at 4 Gy than the three deficient lines, so the comparison confounds Wwox with the identity of five unrelated lines.
entries.snippet: ZR-75–1 and BT-20 cells express normal levels of Wwox and exhibit ~10-fold lower survival at 4 Gy compared to T47D, MDA MB-453 and MDA MB-436 cell lines, which were Wwox-deficient.
entries.anchor: Results, Wwox-deficient cells exhibit increased cell survival

entries.proposition: The second line of evidence compares early (passage 10) and late (passage 23) mouse kidney cells in which Wwox protein is reduced at late passage; passage changes many properties besides Wwox.
entries.snippet: This cell line at late passage (Wwox-reduced) exhibits a significant and striking survival compared to the early passage at 4 Gy (P<0.0001).
entries.anchor: Results, Wwox-deficient cells exhibit increased cell survival

entries.proposition: The patient-level claim is a Kaplan-Meier Plotter comparison in ovarian cancer patients given platinum (n = 1185) of progression-free survival by Wwox expression group, with no adjustment, no hazard ratio and no stage or treatment covariates stated in the text.
entries.snippet: Kaplan–Meier analysis revealed that ovarian cancer patients with Wwox-deficient cancers that received Platinum-based chemotherapy exhibited shorter progression-free survival (n = 1185) compared to patients with Wwox-expressing cancers (Fig. 5A).

entries.proposition: The co-loss claim is that Wwox expression is lower (P < 0.05) in the Fhit-low group of a TCGA squamous lung cohort, from expression normalised to GAPDH and ranked groups; the text reads it as loss of Fhit being quickly succeeded by loss of Wwox (it writes activation of Wwox), a causal order that expression correlation cannot give.
entries.snippet: Fig. 5B demonstrates that the average expression for Wwox was significantly decreased (P< 0.05) in the Fhit-low group compared to the Fhit-normal group, suggesting loss of Fhit is accompanied by reduction in expression of Wwox.
entries.anchor: Results, loss of Fhit occurs frequently with loss of Wwox
